mechanism: Rilpivirine is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase levodopa exposure and carbidopa metabolism, potentially enhancing dopaminergic side effects; both drugs can contribute to CNS effects including psychiatric symptoms.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa adverse effects (dyskinesias, hallucinations, psychosis, orthostatic hypotension); consider levodopa dose reduction if CNS toxicity emerges; ensure adequate spacing of administration if possible.
